description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing device authentication tokens, including their persistence and retrieval, within an Android application. It includes data models, storage interface, and implementation that interacts with secure preferences, handling token normalization and metadata management.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing an authentication token entry for a device, including token string, role, scopes, and the last updated timestamp.

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Serializable internal data class used to store scopes and last update timestamp as metadata for device auth entries.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device authentication tokens and related data.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Concrete implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore interfacing with SecurePrefs to store and retrieve device auth tokens and associated metadata.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a DeviceAuthEntry for a given device ID and role from secure storage.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a device authentication token along with its scopes and timestamp to secure storage.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the stored token and metadata for a specified device ID and role.

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Generates a key string for token storage based on device ID and role.

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Generates a key string for metadata storage based on device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Normalizes the device ID by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Normalizes role string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Normalizes list of scope strings by trimming, filtering out empty strings, removing duplicates, and sorting.
